All of the shares offered hereby are being sold by AirCal Inc. Prior to this offering there has
been no public market for the Common Stock of AirCal Inc. See "Underwriting" for information
relating to the factors considered in determining the initial public offering price.
This offering involves certain considerations which investors should evaluate carefully before
purchasing the Common Stock offered hereby. See "Risk Factors."
